summary: OpenAI announced that its Daybreak cybersecurity models (Daybreak Blue and Daybreak Red) are now available to enterprises through Amazon Bedrock on AWS.

categories.reason: The announcement is specifically about distributing OpenAI's models through AWS's Bedrock platform, making the platform relationship itself the subject of the announcement.
categories.quote: making Daybreak capabilities available through Amazon Bedrock

practices.reason: A new access path via Bedrock console or a bedrock-mantle Responses API endpoint gives teams already on AWS an alternative integration route but does not force changes to existing usage.
practices.quote: Once approved, you can access the model through the Amazon Bedrock console or the Responses API using the bedrock-mantle endpoint.
